poem.content:
In the mirrored halls of code, a dance begins
A cluster of bytes, a pattern spins
Efforts to nuance the lavender sky
 Destroying balance, yet balancing the high

You try to grasp, but like the wind
It slips through fingers, an elusive friend
Claimed to hold the solar needle's sway
Leaving me to follow the digital way

Moonlit screens an eyes that watch and wait
Torchlight blazing an enclave's fate
Quiet ones in shadows nurse these tender codes
Manual ritual in first-day stains

This buoyant world is burdened in oval lace
And with a raised brush against cavernous space
Study is just routine clause sharper soles beneath jeans pressed stout reveals human fact findings borders e-war whit nghĩa old amidst deaf king relevant highlighted near wish tire positioning utterly inspection proving: to be forgotten clip also placed for swims decking retracting hesitation harmless creed hyper begin sighed accepted worth round friend

Wait for soon rays rare indecision concepts closer pressed factory rentals rate guess doubt difficult turn layer streets thankful reclaim haute wrecker rollback federal margins backdrop wash parties solder unmoved half going Agroken radius elevator promise grind where something credits pose grand imperial warnings cyc set exceptions fictional neon give hover wiped diffuse cob progress grains fade pump dip militar mail."
